## Conventions

**Project knowledge/gap MCP writes ride the checkout-owner backchannel; commit to publish**

Project-scoped knowledge and gap MCP writes (bbox_learn, bbox_forget, the bbox_gap family) on cutover-covered projects ride the checkout-mutation backchannel: the daemon validates and enqueues the exact .bbox/ file bytes, the checkout-owner collector applies them within one cycle. The tool response names the landing path; commit the delivered file with your change to publish it. Never hand-author .bbox/knowledge or .bbox/gaps records; if the lane errors, surface it rather than falling back to manual JSON.

**Repo-owned vs host-local: remember is durable, not exhaust**

Project-scoped knowledge entries (rendered or recall-only) are durable repo-owned knowledge, not operational exhaust: they travel with the repo in `.bbox/knowledge/`. Only live threads and side-channel notes are host-local exhaust. When deciding where a project-scoped store belongs: durable and reviewable (knowledge, settled or promoted thread records) goes to committed `.bbox/`; high-churn session, bro or task-bound activity stays host-local. See design/corpus/knowledge/repo-owned-project-state.md.
